citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 2:47 pm on 29-July-
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the door and leaving a voicemail at the phone
number on file. The licensee returned the phone call and informed the inspector that he would not be available for an
inspection today. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and
regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
